blocks.text: Tencent Hy3 is a open-source language model from Tencent, released on Jul 6, 2026.
At $0.2 input and $0.8 output per million tokens, it ranks #7 of 40 for input price, placing it mid-range on input cost.
Its context window of 262K tokens ranks #34 of 41 for context depth in this dataset.
It targets coding, reasoning, agents workloads.
295B total / 21B active MoE (192 experts, top-8 routing); no-think plus low/high chain-of-thought modes. Apache 2.0.
